name: Ouritsu Nekomimi Gakuen ~Anata no Tame no Hatsujouki♪~
original_name: 王立ネコミミ学園～あなたのための発情期♪～
source:
There is a mysterious school far to the east that is attended by students and teachers with animal ears. These are fake ears, but it's an important tradition of the school. But protagonist recognizes in a new transfer student a real half-human girl. He gets culture festival executive committee member position to get to know various student girls better.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
在遥远的东方有一所神秘的学校，里面的学生和老师都长着兽耳。这些是假耳朵，但这是学校的重要传统。但主角在新转校生中认出了一个真正的半人类女孩。他获得了文化节执行委员会委员的职位，以便更好地了解各种女学生。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
